# Test fixtures
Local fixtures are synthetic and generated by `generate.mjs` (`npm run fixtures`): hand-built minimal PDFs with empty pages and a plain-text file. No third-party documents or images. Dedicated to the public domain under CC0 1.0. They only cover the MCP layer (paths, sniffing, size checks, wiring).

PDF-content fixtures come from the core, not from this repo: encrypted PDF, annotated PDF (JS/Launch/widget/page /AA/URI), damaged/bomb PDFs, JPEG with GPS EXIF, broken/unsupported images, etc. are shipped by `@local-pdf-tools/core/fixtures` (git dependency `github:swtormy-agents/pdf-tools#<sha>`). Do not copy or re-create them here; import them in tests once the core dependency is added. The behaviour they test (metadata stripping, /Annots cleanup, 1000-page limit, image header checks) belongs to the core; MCP tests only check that the resulting core error codes are mapped and files are written safely.
